children: The amount of Bitcoin investment capital sitting in unrealized losses has climbed to a record high after the cryptocurrency's sharp drop, according to an analysis.
On-chain analyst Darkpost wrote on X, formerly Twitter, on November 21 that Bitcoin investment capital currently in unrealized losses had reached an all-time high.

With Bitcoin trading at about $58,000 and its market capitalization at about $1.17 trillion, capital held at a loss totaled about $950 billion, Darkpost said. By contrast, capital still in profit was only about $119 billion.
The figures show how large the pool of loss-making capital has become and how much pressure investors are facing, Darkpost added.

title: [Analysis] Bitcoin Investment Capital in Unrealized Losses Nears $950 Billion
